elText: Kei waenganui ngā mōkihi e tino whakamahia ana; ka hangaia ngā mea katoa e karapoti ana ki runga i a rātou. sources: Ngā rā: te wā i puta ai ia kōnae i tōna ara o nāianei, me te tuku tuatahi o ia pūranga. Ngā paita: te gzip o te mātāpuna o ia kōnae, kōnae ki te kōnae, kāore i whakaurua te waehere a te hunga tuatoru.
